svg.title: Air traffic controller — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as air traffic controller, wearing a collared shirt and a communications headset. Visible work cue: A circular radar display has two full radii defining an open sweep sector and one separate target blip. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a communications headset.
